benchmark_access_audit.coverage_note: Python audit events (open/os.open/listdir/scandir/mkdir/remove/rename) in the main process and every forked DataLoader worker. pyarrow reads the TRAIN relation natively after the audited Python SHA256 open, and is only ever given that exact path.
benchmark_access_audit.image_access_note: Every canonical face path is classified against the frozen TRAIN relation only (split metadata is never read). VAL/TEST image accesses are bounded above by the non-TRAIN face accesses, which must be 0.
